column1: # XEX2 integration targets: the executables this project builds and runs
# ("local.integration targets ..."). A target that is present must have exactly
# this SHA-256 and size, be XEX2 and read with this identity; any difference fails.
# A target that is absent on this machine is reported and skipped.
# Everything else under .local/inputs is only inventoried (local.inventory ...),
# where older formats are listed as unsupported, with the reason.
